# Make Rich Text From HTML

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Creates Rich Text from provided HTML.

## Syntax

~~~~text
richTextFromHTML(html: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
richTextFromHTML(html: Downloaded Document)
~~~~
